budget.t0_basis: first observed UTC clock at task entry

label: RESEARCH_HOST_EXPERIMENT / RUNTIME_NOT_QUALIFIED

PHYSICAL_TASK_VALID: full task or preregistered legal segment

allowed_inputs: Original deployable observations/commissioned belief/current task reference/history only; evaluation truth never enters selection
truth_firewall: evaluation truth used only after execution, never selection
hypotheses: Historical FAST slowdown source is unknown; compare exact implementation, measurement and within-run conditions before attributing
Frozen M2 can physically execute nonzero native coordination with unchanged safety, irrespective of FAST engineering qualification
Paired raw force changes require separate phase-duration and moment attribution
setup: Existing nominal and legal prefix conditions; development smoke and bounded matched pairs, no new held-out/generalized claim
issued_count_semantics: modifiable issued proposals, never silently committed count
guard_policy: guard-on min(40,55-36)=19ms; guard-off retains 40ms physical bridge deadline and original 100ms lifecycle/current admission/ownership; classify before changing
repair_policy: one evidence-based M2 adapter repair; no controller/physics/safety/planner or Q changes
phase_attribution: raw complete task integrals, no trimming; symmetric duration and mean-force decomposition, moment integral/peak retained
exclusions: none; all failures retained; incomplete pairs not valid pairs
stop_policy: stop individual run for actual safety/causality/native permission failure; FAST engineering alone does not stop Track B; heavy dispatch stops final20min
